Compare website facts (opening hours, address, phone, booking URL, business name) against Google Business Profile/Maps and other authoritative public profiles when available, then use AI-assisted reasoning to surface cross-channel inconsistencies. Reuse existing local-presence evidence and avoid treating partial/ambiguous external profile data as ground truth.

Add a Google Business Profile/Maps audit layer covering NAP consistency, opening hours, primary/secondary categories, website and booking links, review volume/recency/responses, profile completeness, photo coverage/quality/recency, logo/cover/exterior/interior/team imagery, and cross-channel consistency with the website. Use deterministic profile facts where possible and AI/vision only for subjective photo/profile quality, with evidence and confidence.
